snippet.title: Ys X: Proud Nordics - Release Date Announcement Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
A new adventure awaits in Ys X: Proud Nordics when it launches on February 20, 2026 for PS5!

Experience Adol and Karja's unforgettable journey across Obelia Gulf with new quality of life improvements, then discover a new story centering newcomers Canute and Astrid and the mysterious Öland Island. Finally, challenge yourself in the devious, time-trial dungeon of Muspelheim, where every second counts. Your new adventure awaits in this definitive edition of Ys X: Nordics!

#ps5 #ps5games #ysx
